snippet.text: theorem correctionJet_eta_bound (c : Parameters) (hsmall : c.lam ≤ 1/120) {amp : ℝ → ℝ} {eta amp' : ℝ} (ha : HasDerivAt amp amp' eta) (heta : |eta| ≤ 1) (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ) : |deriv (fun t => correctionJet c amp k t y) eta| ≤ (4 * correctionJetBound c.P c.m k) * Real.exp (-(1 / (4 * c.lam))) * (1 + |amp'|) — one parameter derivative only
